# Offline DOCX renderer

The locally bundled browser builds run only for DOCX template inspection and export. They are distributed with their upstream license files.

- [docx-preview 0.4.1](https://github.com/VolodymyrBaydalka/docxjs/tree/c533f383069008d4a1e05c6171ef8777fd078385) is Apache-2.0 licensed.
- [JSZip 3.10.1](https://github.com/Stuk/jszip/tree/v3.10.1) is used under the MIT option of its dual license. Its bundled components and their notices are described in the accompanying JSZip license file.
- [xmldom 0.9.12](https://github.com/xmldom/xmldom/tree/0.9.12) supplies file-based XML parsing and serialization under the accompanying MIT license.
